title: Acquire a first residual preimage while retaining the mean-node gap
statement: For h_b(y)=E g(by+sqrt(1-b^2)Z),0<b<1, residual sym(K_b Dh_b)-kappa^2I has a P_a^G preimage with unbiased four-original-value action under(kappa^2/a^2)*2b^2/(1-b^2)<=beta<1. Pathwise norm<=(b^2L^2+kappa^2)||v||. Starting h_b(G) remains an unacquired conditional mean.

requires: Original whole-vector g values; Gaussian seeds and exact-real arithmetic
Raw conservative globally Lipschitz C1,1 source; no convexity, derivative or mean oracle
Common correlated centers, then fresh secant seeds
provides: Exact source covariance restoration including off-diagonal cancellation
Fixed-center m-word preimage at2m original values under(kappa^2/a^2)sum t_i^2/(1-t_i^2)<=beta<1
assumptions: Does not cover arbitrary adaptive centers
Cannot take b to1 at fixed nonzero kappa
One unbiased g value replacing h_b changes the incoming law
costs: Four original values and O(d) vector work
Actual correction energy<=pi^2(b^2L^2+kappa^2)^2d/(8a^2), not automatically small residual energy
Mean acquisition, later preimages, coefficient closure, fixed noise and recursive caps remain open
contract.units: Original values and paid Gaussian covariance
contract.obstruction: No acquired reusable quadratic compiler, every-execution polylog query theorem, universal bit bound, priority or practical advantage.

evidence.quote: does not acquire the starting smoothed mean h_b(G) itself
evidence.range_scope: Four-value first residual preimage under a covariance budget; starting mean unacquired.

evidence.quote: Source-only P_rho restores bounded inversion precisely when rho<=a
evidence.range_scope: Smoothed affine inverse/action, sharp strict-noise-gauge obstruction and conditional nonlinear law step.

body: Closes one first-action interface, not the starting program or an arbitrary inverse-heat oracle.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
